judged_text: The guard `embeddable_hosts.cmd_tuples > 0` is always false for a SELECT in PostgreSQL (PQcmdTuples returns 0 for SELECT statements), so the guarded INSERT block never runs, while the following `DELETE FROM site_settings WHERE name IN ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')` executes unconditionally. Every existing site's configured embeddable hosts are silently destroyed from site_settings with zero rows created in embeddable_hosts; after deploy, EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? returns false for all referers, breaking embedding site-wide (embed_controller/topic_retriever now depend on the table), and admins have no record of what hosts they had configured to re-enter.

record.issue_text: [BUG] The guard `embeddable_hosts.cmd_tuples > 0` is always false for a SELECT in PostgreSQL (PQcmdTuples returns 0 for SELECT statements), so the guarded INSERT block never runs, while the following `DELETE FROM site_settings WHERE name IN ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')` executes unconditionally. Every existing site's configured embeddable hosts are silently destroyed from site_settings with zero rows created in embeddable_hosts; after deploy, EmbeddableHost.host_allowed? returns false for all referers, breaking embedding site-wide (embed_controller/topic_retriever now depend on the table), and admins have no record of what hosts they had configured to re-enter.

adjudication.rationale: The migration does `embeddable_hosts = execute("SELECT value FROM site_settings WHERE name = 'embeddable_hosts'")` and guards on `embeddable_hosts.cmd_tuples > 0` before reading `embeddable_hosts[0]['value']`. From the diff alone, it’s not verifiable that `cmd_tuples` is “always false” for a SELECT on PostgreSQL; `execute` returns a DB result object where `cmd_tuples` is commonly used as the row-count for SELECTs (i.e., 0 when no rows, 1 when one row). Therefore the claim that the INSERT block “never runs” and that hosts are “silently destroyed” cannot be concluded from the diff itself.
